model: strict-v80 LightGBM with exact-income hierarchical TE fallback, 40 folds
hypothesis: an unseen exact-income code has more local target support in the same training domain at $10 then $100 resolution than in the global prior
unique_primary_variable: for the existing Annual_Income_USD TE columns only, replace an unseen exact code value with the same-domain income_bin10 value, then income_bin100 value, then the same-domain global prior

historical_overlap_audit.nearest_precedent_boundary: separate bin TE columns remain unchanged; none conditionally replace only an unseen exact-income value

strict_prior_contract.inner_hold: prior and category statistics use only that inner-train partition
strict_prior_contract.outer_valid: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition
strict_prior_contract.test: prior and category statistics use the complete outer-fit partition

comparison_boundary: overall OOF compares the same rows against strict v80; fold wins are fixed seed-42 row buckets applied to both complete OOF vectors

diversity_screen.meaning: only permits a later separately preregistered blend test
